name: UXPin
description_en:
UXPin is a UI design and interactive prototyping tool that emphasizes code-backed components. Teams can assemble an interface from coded libraries, add state and logic, and hand off React code and specifications.

Built-in libraries, Storybook integration and a private Git component library have different plan requirements. A prototype can show application behavior without supplying a production backend.
description_zh:
UXPin 是强调代码组件的 UI 设计和交互原型工具。团队可用代码化组件搭建界面、添加状态和逻辑，并交接 React 代码及规格。

内置组件库、Storybook 接入和私有 Git 组件库有不同套餐条件。原型可以展示应用行为，但不自动提供生产后端。

core_features.explanation_en: Variables and logic can model state-dependent prototype behavior.

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The homepage describes selecting a built-in coded library or syncing a component repository, assembling a high-fidelity prototype and exporting React code. Variables, expressions and conditional interactions model more than links between static screens. Component availability matters: an imported repository and a built-in MUI library are not the same setup or ownership arrangement.
sections.zh: 首页介绍选择内置代码库或同步组件仓库、搭建高保真原型并导出 React 代码。变量、表达式和条件交互可以模拟比静态页面跳转更复杂的行为。组件来源很重要：导入仓库与使用内置 MUI 库，在准备和权利安排上并不相同。

sections.title_zh: 示例：有条件逻辑的结账原型
sections.en: Build a checkout form with a variable for the selected delivery method and a conditional state showing its corresponding message. Test an empty value, a changed selection and a return to the previous step. Exported UI code can inform implementation, but verify dependencies, accessibility and server validation before production. The example does not claim UXPin implements payment processing or persistence.
sections.zh: 搭建结账表单，用变量保存配送方式，通过条件状态显示对应信息。检查空值、更改选择和返回上一步的行为。导出的 UI 代码可辅助实现，但上线前仍需检查依赖、无障碍和服务端校验。本例不表示 UXPin 实现支付处理或数据持久化。

sections.title_en: Seats, AI credits and library integration
sections.title_zh: 席位、AI credits 与组件库接入
sections.en: The monthly price view lists Core at $49/seat and Growth at $69/seat; annual-billing equivalents show $29 and $40 per month per seat. Core includes 200 monthly AI credits and Growth 500, while add-on credits have separate prices. Growth lists Storybook, roles and design systems; Enterprise lists Git integration and custom pricing. The FAQ says a 14-day trial can become a limited Free plan, and the comparison lists two Free prototypes. Trial access should not be confused with the continuing free entitlement.
sections.zh: 月付视图列出 Core 每席位每月 49 美元、Growth 69 美元；年付折算分别为每席位每月 29 和 40 美元。Core 每月含 200 AI credits，Growth 含 500，额外 credits 另收费。Growth 列出 Storybook、角色和设计系统，Enterprise 列出 Git 接入并需询价。FAQ 说明 14 天试用后可保留受限 Free，对照表列出 Free 两个原型。试用权益不能等同于持续免费权益。

sections.title_en: Pilot the component and handoff path
sections.en: Begin with a built-in library and a small interactive flow, then verify the exact component properties and exported code with the developer who will maintain it. A custom library requires its own integration work and an eligible plan. UXPin is relevant when realistic component behavior is central; a static illustration task may not justify that setup. Library licenses, production suitability, offline behavior and self-hosting were not established by this documentation review.
sections.zh: 先用内置组件库搭建小型交互流程，再与维护开发者确认具体组件属性和导出代码。自有组件库另需接入工作及相应套餐。当真实组件行为很重要时，可以考虑 UXPin；仅需静态插图的任务可能不需要这些准备。组件库许可、生产适用性、离线行为和自托管未在本次文档研究中确认。
